cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tonight's courtyard film, fold the moon while I switch off the lamps. All those paper-folding lessons with me must be worth something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the crescent; there's your crease. You used to ask me where to begin even when I'd marked the line.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're ready to work without my hands over yours. I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you take the moon. Can I put your name beside blackout?
